_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-11-10 - entries are ACTIVE-or-UPCOMING as of that date (activeUntil >= today). The dedicated 'Untappd Check-In Challenge: Week 2' post (part of the ongoing Season 1 series already flagged in special_badges_pending_review.json) revealed computable criteria this check - 'check in any IPA' - so its own entry was added below; Week 1's badge ('check in any drink') stays uncomputable and Weeks 3-10 remain unrevealed, per the pending-review note. No other new 'New Badge' posts were found since the prior 2026-11-09 check, and no existing entries needed pruning (the list was already empty). New posts whose criteria this schema can't compute (brewery-specific, venue-location, or otherwise ambiguous) are logged in special_badges_pending_review.json instead of guessed here. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.

special_badges.note: Check in any one (1) IPA in the window to unlock this week's Check-In Challenge badge (a second, non-style RTD check-in earns a bonus sweepstakes entry but isn't required for the badge itself, so it's not modeled here). Post explicitly says 'any IPA counts... West Coast, Hazy, Double, Session, Cold IPA, Black IPA, Brut IPA, and everything in between', i.e. the whole umbrella category - confirmed via the live beer/top_rated style dropdown that every current IPA leaf is shaped 'IPA - X' (American, Hazy/New England, Imperial/Double, Session, Cold, Black/Cascadian Dark Ale, Brut, etc.) with no leaf named bare 'IPA', so the bare substring matcher 'IPA' (per _split_style_matchers' documented umbrella-entry convention) correctly covers all of them. No dedicated badge-artwork image found on the post (only the shared Season 1 header/OG image, reused across weekly posts), so no 'icon' field.
